description.text: A collection launched on 19 June 2026 with nine illustration rare–style promos of the first partners of Johto, Unova and Galar. Each collection held a pack of three of the nine, with two more booster packs and a sticker sheet. Side by side, each region's three cards make one long picture: Chikorita, Cyndaquil and Totodile of Johto, Snivy, Tepig and Oshawott of Unova, Grookey, Scorbunny and Sobble of Galar.
